response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with roughly 15+ years of experience and recent exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP), but his career has been consistently at Senior/Staff IC level without evidence of director-level strategic scope, executive customer advisory work, or recognized AI product leadership required for this Principal Engineer AI Strategy role.
strengths: Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure with 15+ years of hands-on engineering
Recent direct involvement in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq
Demonstrated entrepreneurial drive via founding and sustaining an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective) for nearly a decade
concerns: No evidence of director-level or strategic advisory experience with external customers/partners on cloud or AI adoption
AI-specific experience is recent (since April 2025) and not deep or 'recognized expertise' level; no AI-related advanced degree or published AI thought leadership
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff IC roles without progression into leadership or strategy-influencing positions expected at Principal/Director level

key_factors.factor: Limited and recent AI depth vs. required recognized AI expertise
Solid overall engineering tenure and breadth (15+ years, cloud/infra exposure)
